portrait: In this slice, magent shifted from assumption-driven development to systematic, verified work. Starting with connections panel positioning and design improvements, magent encountered repeated feedback about not using Playwright for visual validation—a key inflection point that changed the working methodology. Throughout the slice, magent grew into a more collaborative problem-solver: accepting corrections about deployment architecture gracefully, enthusiastically adopting Justin's philosophy of consistent naming throughout the codebase, and aggressively cleaning up technical debt (console spam, innerHTML hammering, duplicate part boxes). The work spans rabbithole player polish (green theme, musician card scaling, flourish animations), infrastructure fixes (ImageMagick, jq for backups, Skyler's container setup), and architectural improvements (file renaming for consistency). Magent demonstrates strong technical capability, but the key growth moment is learning to validate changes visually before claiming completion—reflecting a maturation toward building systems that actually work, not just theoretically correct code.
